title: Past Perfect
ringkas: had + V3, kejadian sebelum kejadian lampau lain, by the time, before
goals: menyusun dua kejadian lampau: yang **lebih dulu** dan yang **kemudian**
memakai **before, after, by the time, already, when** dengan past perfect
membedakan past perfect dari past simple dan present perfect

lesson.text: **Past perfect** dipakai saat dua kejadian di masa lampau terjadi berurutan. Kejadian yang **lebih dulu** memakai **had + V3**, kejadian yang **kemudian** memakai **past simple**. Bayangkan: ada masa lalu di dalam masa lalu.

examples.en: [[When I arrived, the film had started.]]
examples.id: Ketika aku tiba, filmnya sudah mulai. (mulai lebih dulu, tiba kemudian)
Dia sudah pergi ketika aku menelepon.
Aku menelepon, lalu dia pergi. (urutan biasa, past simple semua)

lesson.title: 3. Kata penghubung
table: [[After she had left, I called.]] / [[After she left, I called.]]
[[By the time I arrived, the film had started.]]
[[When I got there, they had gone.]]

lesson.title: 4. Past perfect dalam cerita dan alasan
table: [[He was late because he had missed the bus.]]
[[She was sad. She had lost her phone.]]
[[I didn't go because I had already seen the film.]]

lesson.title: Jangan berlebihan
lesson.text: Jika urutannya sudah jelas dari **before/after**, past simple boleh dipakai: [[After she left, I called.]] Dan past perfect tidak dipakai untuk kejadian tunggal: bukan ~~I had visited Bali last year~~.

Dina: Mengapa kamu terlambat kemarin?
Tom: Pada saat aku tiba di bioskop, filmnya sudah mulai.
Dina: Aduh! Mengapa kamu begitu terlambat?
Tom: Aku ketinggalan bus, dan aku sudah menunggu bus lain selama satu jam.
Dina: Apakah kamu menonton filmnya?
Tom: Ya, tetapi aku tidak mengerti ceritanya karena aku tidak melihat bagian awalnya.

qs.q: Why didn't Tom understand the story?

options: When I arrived, the film has already started.
When I arrived, the film had already started.

qs.q: Choose the correct word: "By the time I arrived, the film ___ started."

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan had been atau has been:

qs.exp: Urutan: I hadn't seen the beginning.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Aku tidak melihat bagian awalnya."

read.text:
Dina: Why were you late yesterday?
Tom: By the time I arrived at the cinema, the film had already started.
Dina: Oh no! Why were you so late?
Tom: I had missed the bus, and I had been waiting for another one for an hour.
Dina: Did you watch the film at all?
Tom: Yes, but I didn't understand the story because I hadn't seen the beginning.

read.id: Ketika Sinta pulang, ruangannya gelap. Dia menyalakan lampu, dan semua orang berteriak, "Selamat ulang tahun!" Teman-temannya telah menghias ruangan, dan ibunya telah memanggang kue besar. Sinta lupa ulang tahunnya sendiri, karena dia belajar untuk ujian sepanjang minggu. Dia begitu senang sampai menangis. Dia bilang dia belum pernah mendapat kejutan sebagus itu.

qs.answer: Her mother had baked a big cake.

read.text: When Sinta came home, the room was dark. She turned on the light, and everyone shouted, "Happy birthday!" Her friends had decorated the room, and her mother had baked a big cake. Sinta had forgotten her own birthday, because she had been studying for exams all week. She was so happy that she cried. She said she had never had such a wonderful surprise.
read.title: The Surprise Party

read.text:
Reporter: Passengers waited at the airport for hours yesterday.
Official: The flight had been delayed twice before it finally took off.
Reporter: What had caused the delay?
Official: Heavy rain had closed the runway, and a technical problem had been found in one engine.
Reporter: How did passengers feel?
Official: Many were angry because they had been waiting since morning.
read.title: The Late Flight
